result.requirement: The system shall integrate with external mapping services to consume live traffic and road network data for calculating accurate delivery times.
result.business_need: Accurate delivery time estimates are critical for setting realistic fees, managing customer expectations, and optimizing fleet capacity.
functional_behaviour: The system shall retrieve real-time traffic conditions and road network constraints from the external mapping service.
The system shall calculate dynamic travel duration and distance between the Store Partner and the customer address.
The system shall update the estimated arrival time for the Delivery Assignment based on current traffic patterns.
The system shall validate that the calculated route remains within the active Service Area Definition.
The system shall refresh delivery time estimates whenever significant traffic changes occur during the active delivery window.
related_information_requirements: Calculated estimates of travel duration and distance accounting for traffic patterns
Precise geographic coordinates defining the service zone boundaries
Verified delivery addresses and contact details for the ordering individual
business_rules: The system shall use live traffic data to adjust estimated arrival times whenever congestion exceeds a predefined threshold.
The system shall reject any calculated route that falls outside the authorized Service Area Definition.
The system shall recalculate delivery times immediately upon receiving an update from the external mapping service.
The system shall display the estimated arrival time to the Delivery Partner and Customer within five minutes of the last data refresh.

acceptance_criteria.given: A Delivery Assignment is created with a Store Partner and a valid customer address
acceptance_criteria.when: The system queries the external mapping service for current traffic conditions
acceptance_criteria.then: The system calculates and displays an estimated arrival time that reflects current road congestion

acceptance_criteria.given: A Delivery Assignment is active and traffic conditions change significantly on the route
acceptance_criteria.when: The external mapping service pushes an update regarding road closures or heavy traffic
acceptance_criteria.then: The system updates the estimated arrival time and notifies the Delivery Partner of the delay
